items.label: An Invitation to Nature
items.value: Like a beautiful, majestic tree with silky smooth brown bark, this large bookcase spreads its branches in your living room to sublimate your reading space. Let the peaceful calm of the forest enter your home!

items.label: Storage Galore
items.value: Arrange your books on this tree-shaped shelf to transform it into a magnificent fruit tree. It has 13 compartments to store your books...but that's not all! Put CDs, magazines, decorations, potted plants, and much more!

items.label: Safety Matters
items.value: With side panels and 2 back panels to keep books in place, rounded corners to prevent bumps, and an anti-tip kit to attach it to the wall, this bookcase offers a feeling of security, keeping both your books and you in good hands

items.label: Spacious but Compact
items.value: Have you always dreamed of having a real library at home but are short on space? This compact shelf measuring 9.8”D x 33.9”W x 55.1”H fits easily into a living room, bedroom, or office that you thought was too small

items.label: No Lonely Waiting
items.value: Here, good things don’t need to wait; with step-by-step instructions and numbered parts included, you’ll set this bookshelf up and ready to hold your book collection!

items.label: Specific Uses for Product
items.value: Books, CDs, Magazines, Decorations, Potted Plants

items.label: Item Dimensions D X W X H
Included Components
items.value: 1 x Bookshelf, 1 x Anti-Tip Kit, 1 x Assembly Kit, 1 x Instructions
